overview.title: Stock Opname Flow
overview.summary: Stock opname is a physical asset audit for your branch, compared against what the system has on record. The flow goes:
steps: Draft — all assets are added automatically, you fill in the check results
Approval — waits for approval following your branch's approval flow
Execute — findings are applied to the asset data
Finished — asset data is updated and can no longer be changed
overview.tip: A stock opname can be rejected during the Approval or Execute stage if something's wrong.

createDraft.title: 1. Create a New Stock Opname
createDraft.summary: Open the Stock Opname menu, then click "Create Stock Opname".
steps: The opname date is always today — it can't be changed manually
Add notes if needed (optional), then save
Once saved, ALL assets in your homebase branch are added automatically — no need to add them one by one
createDraft.tip: There's no longer a "one asset can only be in one active stock opname" restriction — you can create a new stock opname anytime, even for a branch that already has another one in progress, or on the same day.

fillSingle.title: 2. Fill Findings — One at a Time
fillSingle.summary: Best when you only need to update a few assets.
steps: On the detail page, find the asset you want to check
Click "Fill Finding" (or "Edit Finding" if it's already filled)
Upload the Physical Proof Photo — required for every asset before the stock opname can be submitted
Choose Physical Status: Exists / Missing / Borrowed
If you choose "Borrowed", also upload a Loan Document — accepted formats (PDF/Word/Photo) and whether it's required are set by an admin on the Config page
Choose Condition — if Physical Status is "Missing" or "Borrowed", Condition auto-locks to "Not Applicable"
Fill in Asset Status if it changed, and Notes if needed
Click "Save Finding"

fillGrid.title: 3. Fill Findings — Complete Data (many assets at once)
fillGrid.summary: Best when checking many assets in a row without opening/closing popups.
steps: On the detail page, click "Complete Data"
A full-screen spreadsheet-like view opens — one row per asset, edit cells directly
Click the camera icon in the Photo column to upload the Physical Proof Photo — required for every asset
If Physical Status is set to "Borrowed", a Loan Document column appears — click its icon to upload
Just type — no need to click save each time, it autosaves every 8 seconds
Watch the small indicator top-right for save status (Saving... / Saved)
Don't want to wait? Click "Save Now"
Lots of assets? Press Ctrl+F (Cmd+F on Mac) to search by name or asset number
fillGrid.tip: A row that failed to save (e.g. an invalid Physical Status/Condition pair, or Borrowed status without an uploaded loan document) shows a small red dot — hover it to see why.

fillExcel.title: 4. Fill Findings — Via Excel
fillExcel.summary: Good for offline work, or sending to someone else checking assets on-site.
steps: Click "Download Template" — get an excel file with every asset in this stock opname
Fill in Physical Status, Condition, Asset Status, and Notes columns
Save the file, then click "Upload Result" and pick the filled file
The system processes every row — valid ones are saved right away, invalid ones are reported with the row and reason

submitApproval.title: 5. Submit & Approval
submitApproval.summary: Once every asset has a finding, it's time to submit.
steps: Click "Submit Stock Opname" on the detail page
The stock opname enters the Approval stage, following your branch's approval flow
Track progress under "Approval Status" — see who needs to approve and what's pending
submitApproval.tip: Submit is rejected if any asset: has an empty Physical Status/Condition, has no Physical Proof Photo uploaded, or (if Borrowed and a document is currently required in Config) has no Loan Document uploaded.

execute.title: 6. Execute
execute.summary: Once every approval step is done, the stock opname enters the Execute stage.
steps: An authorized role (e.g. Asset PIC) clicks "Execute Stock Opname"
The system applies every finding to the asset data (condition, physical status, asset status)
After this the stock opname is "Finished" and its data can no longer be changed

reject.title: 7. Reject
reject.summary: If something's wrong during Approval or Execute, the stock opname can be rejected.
steps: Click "Reject" on the detail page
Enter a reason (required, at least 10 characters)
A rejected stock opname can't be resumed — create a new draft if it's still needed

report.title: 8. Reports
report.summary: See a recap of stock opname results per period and branch.
steps: Open Stock Opname → Report
Pick month, year, and branch (or all branches)
View the summary on the dashboard, or open "Detail" for the full recap table
Click "Export" to download the report as excel

config.title: 9. Stock Opname Settings
config.summary: Some stock opname rules can be set on the Config page — accessed via the "Config" button on the Stock Opname list page.
steps: Submission Window — set the monthly start and end day used to flag a submission as "on schedule" (stock opnames can still be submitted anytime, this only affects the status shown on the detail page)
Loan Document Formats — check which file formats are accepted for Borrowed-status assets: PDF, Word, and/or Photo
Required — turn on/off whether a Loan Document is mandatory for Borrowed-status assets
Click "Save" to apply the changes
config.tip: After a stock opname is submitted, the detail page shows "On Schedule" or "Off Schedule" based on the Submission Window active at the time of submit.
